title: The 8 Best Bench Vise 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for bench vise 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at bench vise 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Wilton 28822 Reversible Bench Vise (Model 4650R)
products.blurb: Key specs: 6.5-inch jaw width, Swivel base, Ductile iron base, cast iron body.
strengths: Ductile iron construction resists cracking under heavy impact far better than cast iron
Swivel base rotates and locks for working from any angle around the bench
Built-in pipe jaws add versatility for round stock and metalwork alongside wood tasks
The reference general-purpose bench vise for a mixed-use shop
limitations: Heavy, needs a solidly built bench section to mount
Higher price than basic import vises
features: Ductile iron base, cast iron body
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Yost Vises 445 Combination Vise
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.5-inch jaw width, Swivel base, Cast iron body.
strengths: Built-in anvil surface adds a striking area for light metalwork tasks
Swivel base at a fraction of premium vise pricing
Solid cast iron holds up to years of general shop use
limitations: Smaller jaw width limits capacity on larger stock
Swivel lock can loosen over time and needs occasional retightening
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Yost Vises 250 2.5-Inch Clamp-On Bench Vise
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5-inch jaw width, Clamp-on mount, no drilling required, 30,000 PSI gray iron casting.
strengths: Very low price for a basic general-purpose vise
Clamp-on mount works well in a small shop with limited bench space and no drilled mounting holes
Adequate for light hardware assembly and holding tasks
limitations: Limited clamping force compared to bolted cast iron vises
Not rated for heavy metalworking or forceful work
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Yost Vises 455 Combination Vise with Anvil, 5.5-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: 5.5-inch jaw width, 360-degree swivel base with lockdowns, 30,000 PSI cast iron with steel U-channel bar.
strengths: Heavy cast iron construction handles serious clamping force without flexing
Built-in anvil face adds a striking surface for light metal shaping
Good middle ground between home shop and industrial-grade vises
limitations: Bulkier footprint than smaller compact vises
Swivel mechanism is stiffer to operate than premium models
features: 30,000 PSI cast iron with steel U-channel bar

products.name: Craftsman 4-Inch Bench Vise with 180-Degree Swivel
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-inch jaw width, 180-degree swivel, Cast iron body.
strengths: Reversible jaw faces flip between smooth and serrated, protecting wood without a separate wood vise
180-degree swivel base for useful working angle flexibility
Reliable, well-known brand with wide parts availability
limitations: Not as robust under heavy impact as Wilton or Grizzly
Base bolts need periodic retightening under heavy use

products.name: TEKTON 54004 4-Inch Swivel Bench Vise
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-inch jaw width, 360-degree swivel, Cast iron construction.
strengths: Solid cast iron jaws hold up well to everyday shop use
Compact size fits a small bench without dominating the workspace
Smooth swivel action with a positive lock
limitations: Smaller jaw opening limits maximum stock size
Not intended for the heaviest industrial-scale clamping tasks

products.name: Wilton 400S Machinist Bench Vise, 4-Inch Jaw Width
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-inch jaw width, No swivel base (stationary), Precision machined body.
strengths: Precision machined body holds tight tolerances useful for metalwork and fine assembly
Fixed (non-swivel) base is more rigid than a swivel-base equivalent
Serrated steel jaws grip metal stock firmly without slipping
limitations: No swivel base limits working angle flexibility
Serrated jaws will mar wood unless covered with soft jaw caps

products.name: VEVOR Bench Vise with Anvil, 6-Inch Jaw Width
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch jaw width, Built-in anvil, 360-degree swivel locking base.
strengths: Integrated anvil surface handles light hammering and metal shaping tasks without a separate anvil
Swivel base with a positive locking mechanism
Solid ductile iron build at a reasonable mid-range price
limitations: Anvil surface is small compared to a dedicated anvil
Jaw width is modest for larger clamping tasks
